[TPS_SWCT_01265] DataPrototype aggregates an own set of SwDataDefProps ⌈This mechanism is used here in the way that DataPrototype aggregates an own set of SwDataDefProps. Thus, each kind of DataPrototype has the ability to extend or even overwrite the SwDataDefProps already defined by its ApplicationDataType or ImplementationDataType. This mechanism, if carefully applied, allows for a better reuse of data types because they can be kept free of the properties which vary according to the context or are defined in later project phases.⌋() Class DataPrototype (abstract) Package M2::AUTOSART emplates::SWComponentT emplate::Datatype::DataPrototypes Note Base class for prototypical roles of any data type.
